newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee edges up against forward dollar.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee edges up against forward dollar.

text.p: The Indian rupee opened up against the forward dollar and was gaining in Wednesday noon trade, dealers said.
They said a continuation of receiving interest among banks (receiving premia against forward dollar) seen on Tuesday, helped the rupee's rise against the forward dollar.
July dollars opened at 1.40/1.43 rupees on Wednesday, compared to the previous close of 1.46/1.48 rupees. July dollars were quoted at 1.39/1.42 rupees in latest deals.
The spot rupee was quoted at 35.840/847 in latest deals.
